title: The Terminal of Kepler Reach
author: Gideon Pemberton
blurb: Theo Zhou, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
